$comment: Shell-owned action an MFE executes against the screen domain when a member asks to open one artifact. The MFE publishes, the shell owns the answer: a navigation on the router to the editor screen, with the artifact in the address (ADR-0028, #320), echoed back as ...context.artifact.selected.v1~. Nothing in the MFE writes the selection locally — see projects-mfe/src/actions/artifactActions.ts.

projectId.$comment: Tenant id of the project the artifact was listed in.

artifactId.$comment: The node's instance_id in the artifact gear.

repository.$comment: The repository's full_path, as the gear names it. Goes into the address as given; the router serializes / raw.

path.$comment: Checkout-relative path of a file — what studio.openInEditor takes. Empty for kinds that have no path.

kind.$comment: STUDIO_ARTIFACT_KINDS in mfe-shared (host/hostActions.ts), not the gear's type ids. #320 writes this token into the address; only file opens in the editor today.
